rules.O1: E_b = mean over converged samples of E_far - E_near (positive = bound). Category by the brief: > 0.3 eV bound strongly, 0 to 0.3 eV weakly, < 0 unbound. Theorist value counted right if within 0.10 eV or within a log-ratio of 0.3 of E_b. If fewer than 5 of 8 samples converge, O1 stays ungraded.
rules.O2: Sn hops are taken from the persistent state (K = 4 snapshots of 50 steps). A hop reversed (B back to A) within 10 ps is cancelled with its partner; the rest are net Sn hops. Rate k(T) = net Sn hops / (runs x production time). If at least two temperatures have 3 or more net Sn hops, Ea is the weighted least-squares Arrhenius slope over those temperatures, category by the brief's ranges, value right if within 0.15 eV. Otherwise Ea is bounded from below by kB*T_max*ln(1e13 s^-1 x total time at T_max x number of Sn atoms next to a vacancy), and only categories whose whole range lies below the bound are marked refuted; O2 is then reported as partly graded.
rules.vibration_check: Before any O2 grading, the persistence rule is checked on the runs themselves: the fraction of hops cancelled within 10 ps is reported per temperature; if over 90 % at every temperature the event count is treated as dominated by flicker and stated as such.
rules.T1_hypothesis: papers/26 section 3.4: barriers of events seen in MD are compared with the T3 literature activation energies (2.9 to 3.3 eV bulk Ge; 1.1 to 1.8 eV metastable films). The comparison is reported, not used to change any earlier entry.
